# PKD2L1 pH modulation in CSF-cNs

## **0 CSF-cNs discharge in pH in control**

### **a1) Frequency in control**

```{r}

library(readxl)

FCTR<- read_xlsx("FreqCTR.xlsx")
 
#View(FCTR)
names(FCTR)

FCTR$Cell ->Cell
FCTR$Region ->Region
FCTR$Cond->Cond
FCTR$Freq->Freq
FCTR$Numb->Numb

FCTR$Region <- factor(FCTR$Region, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))


```

### b1) SUMMARIZE data for discharge frequency in control

```{r}
library(FSA)

Summarize(Freq, digits=1)

Summarize(Freq~Region,
          FCTR,
          digits=1)

```

### c1) PLOT frequency against Regions Control

#### =\> Dots and Mean

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

# Convert columns to factors to ensure proper ordering and grouping
Region <- factor(Region, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))
Cell <- factor(Cell)

# Create the plot
plot <- ggplot(FCTR, aes(x=Region,y = Freq, group = Cell)) +
    geom_line() + 
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~ Region, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(title = "Frequency by Condition and Level",
         x = "Condition",
         y = "Freq") +
    theme_minimal()

# Print the plot
print(plot)
ggsave('plotFCTR.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

summary_stats <- FCTR %>%
    group_by(Region) %>%
    summarise(mean_Freq = mean(Freq, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_Freq = sd(Freq, na.rm = TRUE),
        sem_Freq = sd(Freq, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
        .groups = 'drop'  # Avoid warning message about grouped data
    )
# Print summary statistics
print(summary_stats)

# Create the plot with error bars and lines connecting the points Mean + SEM/SD

## Use the FSA Summarize function to summarize the data by Level and Cond
summary_stats <- Summarize(Freq ~ Region, FCTR, digits = 0)

## Compute SEM (Standard Error of the Mean) manually
summary_stats$sem <- summary_stats$sd / sqrt(summary_stats$n) 

# Ensure the order of Cond and Level in the summarized data
summary_stats$Region <- factor(summary_stats$Region, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))

## Create the plot with error bars (mean ± SEM)
plotFqCSE <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Region, y = mean, color = Region, group = Region)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Region), linewidth = 1) +  # Line connecting points by Cond
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Plot the mean data points
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), width = 0.2) +  # Error bars for SEM
  facet_wrap(~ Region, scales = "free_x") +  # Faceting by Level
  labs(title = "Mean Densities by Condition and Level with SEM",
       x = "Region",
       y = "Mean Freq") +
  theme_minimal()

print(plotFqCSE)

## Create the plot with error bars (mean ± standard deviation)
plotFqCSD<- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Region, y = mean, color = Region, group = Region)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Region), linewidth = 1) +  # Line connecting points by Cond
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Plot the mean data points
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.2) +  # Error bars for SD
  facet_wrap(~ Region, scales = "free_x") +  # Faceting by Level
  labs(title = "Mean Densities by Condition and Level with Standard Deviation",
       x = "Region",
       y = "Mean Freq") +
  theme_minimal()

print(plotFqCSD)

# Print the plot

ggsave('plotFqCSE.eps', units = "cm", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

ggsave('plotFqCSD.eps', units = "cm", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

#### =\> Boxplot & whiskers

```{r}
p0 <- ggplot(FCTR, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Cerv","Tho","Lumb")), y=Freq, color=Region)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5) + theme_minimal()
p0 + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-5, 15))

ggsave('Bx_FCTR.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

p1 <- ggplot(FCTR, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Cerv","Tho","Lumb")), y=Freq, color=Region)) +
   geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitter(0.1))+ theme_minimal()
p1 + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-5, 15))

ggsave('Pt_FCTR.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
```

### d1) STATISTICAL analysis data for discharge frequency Control

### =\> Kruskal wallis test

```{r}

print("Amplitude as a function of the Region")

kruskal.test(Freq~Region, data = FCTR)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(Freq, Region,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Freq ~ Region,
                    data   = FCTR,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 3,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)


```

### c1) PLOT data for discharge frequency pH9

```{r}

# Load necessary packages
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

p0 <- ggplot(F9, aes(x=Region, y=Freq, color=Cond)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5) + theme_minimal()
p0 + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-5, 15))

   geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitter(0.1))+ theme_minimal()
p1 + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-5,15))

ggsave('Pt_F9.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)


# Convert columns to factors to ensure proper ordering and grouping
Cond <- factor(Cond, levels = c("CTR", "pH9", "Wash"))
Region <- factor(Region, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lum"))
Cell <- factor(Cell)

# Create the plot
plot <- ggplot(F9, aes(x=Cond<- factor(Cond,levels = c("CTR","pH9","Wash")), y = Freq, group = Cell, color = Region)) +
    geom_line() + 
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~ Region, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(title = "Frequency by Condition and Level",
         x = "Condition",
         y = "Dens") +
    theme_minimal()

# Print the plot
print(plot)
ggsave('plot.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

summary_stats <- F9 %>%
    group_by(Region, Cond) %>%
    summarise(
        mean_Freq = mean(Freq, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_Freq = sd(Freq, na.rm = TRUE),
        sem_Freq = sd(Freq, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
        .groups = 'drop'  # Avoid warning message about grouped data
    )
# Print summary statistics
print(summary_stats)

# Create the plot with error bars
plotSE <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x=Cond<- factor(Cond,levels = c("CTR","pH9","Wash")), y = mean_Freq, color = Region)) +
    geom_line() + 
    geom_point(size = 3) + 
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_Freq - sem_Freq, ymax = mean_Freq + sem_Freq), width = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ Region) +
    labs(title = "Mean amplitude by Condition and Level with Standard Error to the mean",
         x = "Condition",
         y = "Mean Freq") +
    theme_minimal()

# Print the plot
print(plotSE)
ggsave('plotSE9.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# Create the plot with error bars
plotSD <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x=Cond<- factor(Cond,levels = c("CTR","pH9","Wash")), y = mean_Freq, color = Region)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) + 
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_Freq - sd_Freq, ymax = mean_Freq + sd_Freq), width = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ Region) +
    labs(title = "Mean Densities by Condition and Level with Standard Deviation",
         x = "Condition",
         y = "Mean Freq") +
    theme_minimal()

# Print the plot
print(plotSD)
ggsave('plotSD9.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

```

### d1) STATISTICAL analysis data for discharge modulation by pH9

### =\> Linear model 2 Factors

##### \# Define Linear Model -) region \* Cond

```{r}

print("Amplitude as a function of the condition")

kruskal.test(Freq~Cond, data = F9)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(Freq, Cond,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Freq ~ Cond,
                    data   = F9,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 3,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)

print("Amplitude as a function of the condition and region")

modelF9 = lm(Freq ~ Region*Cond,
           data = F9)
# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelF9)


```

##### \## Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

```{r}
# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

library(car)
Anova(modelF9,type = "II")
```

##### \### Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelF9,
                      ~ Cond*Region,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelF9, ~ Cond*Region)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Region")     # compare doses for each treat

```

### d1) STATISTICAL analysis data for PKD2L1 Np Open against regions

### =\> Kruskal wallis test

##### \# Define Linear Model -) region

```{r}

kruskal.test(pO~Region, data = pCTR)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(pO, Region,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(pO ~ Region,
                    data   = pCTR,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 3,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)

kruskal.test(Perc~Region, data = pCTR)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(Perc, Region,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Perc ~ Region,
                    data   = pCTR,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 3,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)


```
